svg.title: Machine Learning Methodology Diagram — Titanic Survival Prediction
svg.desc: A flowchart showing the full ML pipeline from dataset selection to results, with 7 main stages including data loading, preprocessing, model training, and evaluation.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about selecting the Titanic dataset for ML')
sendPrompt('How do you load a CSV dataset using Pandas?')
sendPrompt('What is exploratory data analysis in machine learning?')
sendPrompt('What data preprocessing steps are needed for the Titanic dataset?')
sendPrompt('Why do we split data into training and test sets?')
sendPrompt('How does Logistic Regression work for classification?')
sendPrompt('How does a Decision Tree classifier work?')
sendPrompt('Why is Random Forest better than a single Decision Tree?')
sendPrompt('What evaluation metrics are used for binary classification?')
sendPrompt('How do you interpret and present ML model results?')

svg.text: Click any step to learn more
